summary: Iteration 106 Friendship Day updates verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests PASSED covering catalog(2 centers/3 workshops), dedupe with workshop_history append, third-register-after-paid → 409, admin PATCH → Student CRM mirror (upsert by email+phone with workshop_history entry containing all required keys), webhook signature enforcement, and Cashfree order verification (return_url starts with https://oll.co/). Frontend: Hero flyer loads from customer-assets-v7afamib (naturalWidth=1399), date text 'Sunday, 2nd August 2026' present with NO forbidden Saturday/1 Aug variants, both centers visible, As Seen On section with all 3 logos (KBC, Shark Tank India, STEM Accredited) present and rendered from customer-assets-v7afamib. Modal opens on hero CTA, order summary updates live (₹499 bracelet / ₹799 combo). On preview build, Cashfree checkout opens in MODAL (redirectTarget='_modal') and the URL stays at /friendship-day even when Cashfree returns 'Broken Link' — exactly as designed (broken link contained inside modal).
critical_code_review_comments: Cashfree return_url is correctly forced to https://oll.co via CASHFREE_RETURN_BASE_URL env default in friendship_day.py:191 — verified by direct PGFetchOrder call.
redirectTarget='_modal' toggle in FriendshipDayLanding.jsx:122-125 correctly whitelists oll.co & eventmate-19.emergent.host for full-page redirect and uses modal on all other preview hosts.
_mirror_paid_to_student_crm helper uses $set/$setOnInsert/$addToSet correctly — no duplicate workshop_history entries on re-mark-paid because $addToSet dedupes on full sub-doc.

Minor: StudentInquiry pydantic model has extra='ignore' so payment_status and workshop_history fields aren't exposed via GET /api/students/inquiries. Not a blocker for Friendship Day CRM tab (which uses its own admin endpoint), but a general-purpose /students/inquiries consumer wouldn't see the mirrored fields.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (Cashfree merchant whitelist for preview domain remains ops item — contained in modal by design)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_* Friendship Day registrations and one TEST CRMMirror Child mirrored to student_inquiries with workshop_history entries.

Preview build now opens Cashfree in modal so 'Broken Link' stays contained. workshop_history mirror to student_inquiries is functional (verified via direct MongoDB read). If retesting, note that the /api/students/inquiries endpoint strips extra fields via StudentInquiry.extra='ignore' — verify mirror via DB or Friendship Day CRM admin endpoint.
